Deprecated ggcircos API

Source: R/deprecated.R
ggcircos-deprecated.Rd

These are the 0.0.0.9000 entry points. They still work, but they warn and forward to their 0.1.0 replacements; see the individual functions for how the old arguments map.

Usage

geom_curve_link(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  arrow = NULL,
  lineend = "butt",
  linejoin = "round",
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_circos(
  mapping,
  geom,
  data = NULL,
  position = "auto",
  pwidth = 0.3,
  offset = 0.02,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  grid.params = NULL,
  axis.params = NULL,
  ...
)

geom_link_lab(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  hjust = 0,
  offset = 0,
  geom = "text",
  as_ylab = FALSE,
  ...
)

as.tbl_lk(x, ...)

tidy_link(x, radius = 1, ...)

Arguments

geom, mapping, pwidth, offset, grid.params, axis.params

Legacy arguments, mapped onto geom_track() and geom_track_axis().
